newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Duff & Phelps rates Uruguay's foreign debt BBB-.
newsitem.headline: Duff & Phelps rates Uruguay's foreign debt BBB-.

text.p: Duff & Phelps Credit Rating Co (DCR) said Tuesday it has assigned a BBB- rating to Uruguay's foreign currency debt.

The agency said in a statement: "DCR's investment-grade rating reflects Uruguay's strong external debt ratios, favorable social indicators, stable political environment and ongoing structural reforms."
The rating company added that Uruguay's rating is constrained by the country's traditionally high inflation rate and its economic dependence on neighboring Argentina and Brazil.
Uruguay's foreign debt and foreign debt servicing charges as a percent of exports are comparable to those of other investment-grade countries, said Duff & Phelps.

Economic deregulation and privatization, the introduction of a private pension funds system, central government reforms and Uruguay's membership of the Mercosur custom union (including Brazil, Argentina and Paraguay) all stand in Uruguay's favor, said Duff & Phelps.
